findings.title: The declared CP0007 review bundle cannot be reconstructed from its sealed subject
findings.observed: Two independent rebuilds from the detached published CP0007 tag were byte-identical and individually valid, but both produced sha256 07bb328a4316297d0b6bd2df986c7b5f5fb41b30c8b2fb58cd99a8d96c24c168 at 751518 bytes. CP0007 declares sha256 8856ce50acebfa02528ad318247c22e6e460c224eb62774c99a35cb5cd734578 at 562710 bytes. The declared review artifact therefore does not describe the archive reconstructed from the final sealed content.
findings.likelyCause: The declared bundle was validated at 2026-10-12T10:01:32Z before the checkpoint's final update/seal at 2026-10-12T10:02:57Z, so later checkpoint evidence changed the canonical bundle payload without a post-seal reconstruction. This is an inference from the sealed timestamps and digest/size mismatch, not a product correction.
findings.requiredCorrection: Make the canonical review transport derivable from the final content it claims to represent, record only its final digest/report as transportable evidence, and prove a remote detached rebuild reproduces that digest before independent approval.
